## OfferChainUtils.getMaxFixedRateOfferChainEndTimestamp() function

Returns the latest supported end timestamp for a fixed-rate offer chain.

Chains intentionally stop before the final part of the maturity window because rate sensitivity accelerates near maturity and would require too many short-lived offers for a stable maker quote. Call this when constraining a make-offer expiry selector, then pass the selected timestamp to the lend-only or borrow-only chain builder.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function getMaxFixedRateOfferChainEndTimestamp(params: {
        readonly maturityTimestamp: BigIntish;
        readonly chainStartTimestamp: BigIntish;
    }): bigint;
```

## Exceptions

`InvalidOfferParameterError` when a timestamp is invalid.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.maturityTimestamp`<!-- -->: Market maturity timestamp in seconds.

- `params.chainStartTimestamp`<!-- -->: First timestamp the chain should cover.

## Example


```ts
import { OfferChainUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const maxExpiry = OfferChainUtils.getMaxFixedRateOfferChainEndTimestamp({
  maturityTimestamp: market.params.maturity,
  chainStartTimestamp: now,
});
console.log(maxExpiry);
```
